CB27-021.name: Sumeragi Lee Noriega
CB27-021.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (CB) (Gundam Meister & Brave) (Blue & Mothership & Nexus)]
◆When you summon/advent/deploy a target Spirit/Brave/Nexus, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Gandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) You can return a "CB"/"Gundam Meister" family Spirit you control to the Hand.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't stack) When your "CB" family Spirit is summoned/reborn, or switched from Hand, by sending five cores from this Nexus to the Void, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.
